scope: Local workerd V8 sampling only; no Cloudflare API or real model requests. Separate API/storage scripts; not billed CPU or production topology.

environment.input: empty conversation; synthetic RS256 JWT and local JWKS
environment.network: local only; no Cloudflare API or real provider calls

assessment.scope: Statistical V8 sample counts only; time deltas include idle and I/O, so neither deltas nor wall time represent per-request or Cloudflare billed CPU. Inclusive counts overlap and must not be added. Selected frames are not exhaustive.
assessment.sourceMapping: api-runtime.js retrieved from the actual API inspector; bundle lines mapped to the sync handler, access lookup and JOSE. Separate storage inspector was excluded.
assessment.finding: JWT verification, access lookup, Hono routing, Headers/Request construction and WebSocket forwarding are present. This identifies candidate paths, not the cause of a specific 18 ms platform event. No model generation occurs in this empty-conversation workload.
assessment.authReview: requireAuth reads the principal stored by authentication middleware; repeated calls are not repeated JWT signature checks. Library.get also excludes copying/importing/deleted conversations; retain those authorization semantics.
assessment.cleanup: Both local Wrangler/workerd processes stopped; temporary runtime state and synthetic credential configs deleted. Raw profiles remain local and ignored.
assessment.release: No production code, authentication, deployment or database changes; platform CPU attribution and DO aggregate evidence still pending.
